attendance.unmatchedTitle: Names in the fingerprint sheet that don't match
attendance.unmatchedSub: Link each name to the right employee so it counts · the next sheet will recognize it on its own
attendance.sourcesNote: Fingerprints arrive in two ways: the device is connected to the system and pulled automatically, or HR uploads the fingerprint sheet (Excel / CSV) exported from the device. Uploading the same sheet again never duplicates a day.
attendance.notWorkDay: Not a working day · no absence
attendance.holidayNote: {day} is an official holiday: {holiday} · no absence that day.
attendance.missingSub: If the device was down, HR completes the day by hand
attendance.tiersNote: Up to 11:16 on time · 11:17 to 11:29 quarter day · 11:30 to 11:59 half day · 12:00 and later a full day. Anyone with custom brackets is calculated by their own brackets, and Part-time as HR set.
attendance.entryNote: Calculated by the brackets right away, and recorded in the Audit Log.

history.pick: Choose an employee to see their attendance

delay.note: Late minutes = Check-in − 11:16 (e.g. 11:18 = 2 minutes). Every minute counts without exception, even for those with custom brackets.

deductions.approvedOk: Deductions approved and posted to Finance
deductions.approvedNote: This month's deductions were approved by {by} {when} and posted to Finance.
deductions.notApproved: This month's deductions aren't approved yet, so they don't show in Finance.
deductions.approveBtn: Approve deductions and send to Finance
deductions.note: Deduction = deduction days × (salary ÷ 26), including the penalties HR approved, plus the KPI reward or deduction of the quarter that closed this month. Each employee's own settings only change the deduction brackets; Weekly Delay minutes are counted the same way for everyone.

employees.customTiers: Custom: quarter from {quarter} min · half from {half} min · day from {day} min
employees.editNote: Minutes after 11:00 (the first 16 minutes aren't late). Changes flow automatically to Finance and Sales, and are recorded in the Audit Log.

excuses.mineSub: This month: {month} · the first two have no deduction, the third and fourth are half a day, the fifth is refused
excuses.confirmedOk: Confirmed · the day is now an Excuse
excuses.title: Excuses
excuses.sub: A ticket to the Team Leader then HR · every Excuse gets an Alarm

ideal.title: Ideal employee and team fund
ideal.sub: The rest of the team's attendance and lateness deductions go to the ideal employee at the end of the month
ideal.earlySub: Days before time · more is better
ideal.note: Conditions: overall KPIs of 80% or more, and no administrative penalty in the month. On a tie: the highest on target, then the highest KPI rate. The amount = the sum of the rest of the team's attendance and lateness deductions in the month (e.g. a team of 5, the other 4's deductions = 3,000 EGP, received by the ideal employee).

leaves.sentToTl: Request sent to the Team Leader
leaves.mineSub: The request goes to the Team Leader then HR
leaves.afterReturn: This leave is recorded after returning, with a document.
leaves.awaitingSub: The Team Leader's rejection is final, and goes back to the employee with the reason
leaves.rejectedOk: Rejected and returned to the employee
leaves.rejectBtn: Reject and return to the employee

care.penaltyRecorded: Penalty recorded · not eligible for ideal employee this month
care.penaltiesSub: A penalty goes to deductions after HR approves it, and keeps the employee from being the ideal employee this month
care.openActionsSub: From 1-to-1 sessions · an Alarm fires on its due date
care.questionsSub: Entered once and shown in every 1-to-1

one.due: This month's 1-to-1 hasn't been done yet.
one.actionPh: If something needs to be done
one.actionDue: HR action due date (you'll get an Alarm)
